content:
**Wade Airport** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia.

Located just off of Interstate 59, outside of the capital city of Charleston, Wade Airport was the local airport for the southern region of Appalachia. The airport housed civilian, military, and commercial aircraft. Several such aircraft and their spare parts can be found on the tarmac, in hangars, and along the terminal.

At the northern end of the runway, there is a Skylanes Air crash site and firetrucks appear around the area. One of the wings is partially in the air traffic control area and a Parking Garage is connected to the main building. The tarmac and some of the out-buildings have been fortified by Super Mutants.

It is a Public Workshop with Claim and Defend events. It also features a Poseidon Power Box, increasing the Workshop's power for a time after completion of Powering Up Poseidon. It also comes with two Vertibot landing pads and three heavy Gun Emplacements for defending the Workshop.

Wade Airport appears in *Fallout 76*.

![UI C Icon QianWangJianTou.png](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/d/dd/UI_C_Icon_QianWangJianTou.png/18px-UI_C_Icon_QianWangJianTou.png) Real World Information: Wade Airport is based on the real-world Yeager Airport and McLaughlin Air National Guard Base, which are similarly located northeast of the city of Charleston, WV.

The wall next to the westernmost exit at the bottom level of the parking garage can be seen and walked through when approached from the inside of the garage.
